fullPassage:
The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.

(B) The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system.

(A) However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world.

(C) Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 식량 안보를 달성하기 위해서는 반드시 식량 자급자족이 필요하다.
미국은 커피, 차, 바나나 등 열대 상품을 자국 내에서 자급자족한다.
농업 생산성이 매우 높은 국가도 모든 식품에서 완전한 자급자족을 이루지는 못한다.
농업 생산물은 기후, 토양 조건에 영향을 받지 않는다.

❌ ② 본문: 'The United States ... depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas' — 수입에 의존한다고 함
❌ ④ 본문: 'highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions' — 민감하다고 함
